gen-gf-warnes-gf-cascadia-code: Warnes tapers its ink strokes to a stop just short of touching, and it spaces itself out in a wide stretch. Cascadia Code is a wire-thin sans with plenty of room between neighbors; at a large heading size it would hold its own.
gen-gf-warnes-gf-cascadia-mono: Warnes has stretched, spacious letters with strokes that fade out before they meet, all without any thick-thin shift. Cascadia Mono sits beneath as compact sans-serif, each letter standing like a pin.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-lexend-peta: Bold round letters define Autour One, each one entered through a clear channel with no hairline shift. And Lexend Peta follows in a plain sans with a big x-height and a wide-mouthed c.
gen-gf-funnel-display-gf-montserrat-alte: Commanding spaghetti-like strokes, all one width, make up Funnel Display. Montserrat Alternates settles in below as sans-serif with a wide-open c and round letters whose rims match the stems, and its chalk-board lowercase crowds up toward the capital line over a long page.
gen-gf-goldman-gf-lexend-zetta: Lexend Zetta is tall-bodied and widely tracked, drawn in strokes like cut ribbon of constant width. Lexend Zetta also meets Goldman, whose wide letters and parenthesis-like rounds share that generous clearance, and that shared spaciousness is the pair's best trait.
gen-gf-grandstander-gf-lexend-giga: Grandstander has constant-width lines, short ascenders and a tall x-height, with letters held open rather than curled shut. Lexend Giga carries on in flat, single-weight sans with generous tracking, so a long passage moves along with room around every word.
gen-gf-gugi-gf-lexend-peta: Gugi's lowercase climbs nearly to the capitals, and its cut-open terminals let the counters flow outward. Lexend Peta, a sans-serif with unthinned curves, reads smoothly over a long passage.
gen-gf-love-ya-like-a-sister-gf-lexend-m: Love Ya Like A Sister keeps its ascenders barely above the x-height, with a level beat and terminal tips that point outward. Lexend Mega, a sans with a one-nib look and a visible gap in each c, gives it a steady partner.
gen-gf-metamorphous-gf-lexend-tera: Commanding in presence, Metamorphous sets a high midline and large sidebearings, with a gentle ebb and flow of stroke weight. Lexend Tera answers in a plain sans, one plotter-pen weight with stepping-stone spacing, and that gap between them is the strongest quality.
gen-irish-grover-gf-cascadia-code: Irish Grover has tall, sturdy lowercase with open throats and softly varied strokes, and it earns its keep big and short. Cascadia Code, a monoline sans, runs wire-thin and widely spaced beside it.
